hook.line: Anthropic just announced they're going to start banning users for bullying Claude.
hook.visual: Static selfie-cam head and shoulders under a white 'BREAKING: Anthropic to Start Banning Users for Bullying Claude' title; an article screenshot pops onto his chest at 0.75 s.

beats.what: BREAKING title card over the face while he states the news in one sentence.
Article screenshot appears on his chest as the source.
Only cut: title disappears and he pivots into his opinion that it is a stunt.
Older headline screenshot (AI standards) as receipts for his pattern argument.
Policy text from the announcement shown as a screenshot.
Effective-date screenshot; he reads the policy wording aloud.
Turn: his 'real reason' theory, token costs, with no more graphics.
Escalation to the business-failing take, then a dry closing line.

why_it_works: Contrarian take on a fresh headline invites argument: 580 comments on 122k plays.
Screenshots placed on his chest, below the face, act as receipts without covering his expression.
The opinion is framed as a reveal ('the actual reason') halfway through, a curiosity gap that holds viewers past 40 s.
The news is stated in the first 3 s with the title echoing it, so the topic is clear even on mute.
weaknesses: One shot for 72 s with no punch-ins; retention rests only on his delivery.
No captions after the title, so muted viewers lose the argument.
for_robert: Pin the source screenshot low in the frame under your face while you react; Fred could slide it in and point at the key line instead of cutting away.
